methods: Read existing planning narrative and source entrypoints

planningMethod: Bottom-up validation plan: paid campaigns x ARPA for revenue, documented cost percentages for unit economics, and explicit pass/fail gates for conversion, deliverability, official coverage, chargebacks, and operator workload.

holes.hole: Users may not pay for a low-frequency civic task.
holes.mitigation: Run paid beta before broad SEO.
holes.residualRisk: Praise without checkout conversion keeps the asset non-investible.

holes.mitigation: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain warming, and bounce monitoring [evidence: scripts/setup-dns.md; MASTER_PLAN.md section 13].
holes.residualRisk: Automated civic email can still be filtered or ignored.

holes.hole: Legal/compliance risk may overwhelm the thin-margin workflow.
holes.mitigation: Not-legal-advice language, user-as-author posture, AI disclosure, moderation, and audit logs [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].
holes.residualRisk: One bad letter or complaint can damage trust.

holes.hole: Project identity conflict weakens dossier trust.
holes.mitigation: Operator ruling on brooks-history versus CivicState by 2026-07-15 [assumption: schedule].
holes.residualRisk: Public pitch is incoherent until resolved.

strategy: Validate a narrow paid constituent-letter loop before expanding to SEO, public campaign pages, organization APIs, certified mail, coalition mechanics, or multilingual support.

goToMarket.first100: Manual beta and issue-community recruitment for first 100 paid campaigns [assumption: validation-first GTM]
channels: Opt-in SEO pages after successful sends [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md sections 9 and 18]

operatorWorkflow: One operator reviews flagged submissions, delivery failures, refunds, official-data exceptions, and treasury discrepancies; routine workload must be measured before business promotion [assumption: operator capacity not validated].
constraints: Workspace-only research; no external claims treated as evidence
Registry Watchlist and personal/research asset note [evidence: wrk.dog dispatch registry note, 2026-06-20]
No legal advice or regulatory filing positioning [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md Executive Summary]

aiWorkGovernance.position: AI drafts and researches, but citations must be verified and risky content must be moderated before delivery [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md SUBM/MODR/LETR].
aiWorkGovernance.disclosures: AI disclosure and not-legal-advice language required [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md LETR/LGAL].
aiWorkGovernance.humanEscalation: Threats block; defamation/unverifiable claims go to human review [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md MODR].
